Immediately Invoked Coroutine Lambdas in C++23 - Lifetime Pitfalls and Best Practices - Jonathan Müller - ACCU 2025 Short Talks
---

Learn how to use immediately invoked coroutine lambdas safely and effectively in modern C++!

In this ACCU 2025 lightning talk, C++ expert Jonathan Müller explores the powerful but dangerous pattern of immediately invoked coroutine lambdas in C++. Coroutines allow asynchronous execution in C++ using constructs like `co_await`, `co_return`, and `co_yield`, but subtle lifetime issues can lead to undefined behavior when using capturing lambdas. This talk dives into how coroutine frames work, what happens when you `co_await` inside an immediately invoked lambda, and how to avoid crashes due to premature destruction of captures.
